newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM targets raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM targets raised.

text.p: CS First Boston and Gruntal & Co said Tuesday they raised their 12-month price objectives on International Business Machines Corp.
-- Gruntal analyst David Takata raised target to $120 per share from $100. Also raised earnings estimates to $6.19 per share from $6.13 for 1997 and to $7.14 from $6.65 for 1998.
-- Gruntal kept buy rating on shares.
-- CS First Boston raised its target to $125 per share from $97.
-- CS First Boston raised earnings estimate to $6.16 per share from $6.12 for 1997 but kept 1998 estimate at $7.15.
-- IBM reported second quarter earnings late Monday of $1.46 per share, $0.04 above the First Call consensus view and up from $1.26 a year ago.
